_note: Week of June 1–7, 2026. Mediterranean pivot. Laine's rules strictly followed. Pita pocket Tuesday replaces taco Tuesday. Jake and Laine cook together, different portions. Laine mason jar lunches unchanged.

dinners.name: Lemon Herb Cod + Quinoa + Cherry Tomatoes
dinners.note: Clean Mediterranean opener. Cod baked in olive oil and lemon, quinoa for fiber, cherry tomatoes stirred in at the end so they blister slightly. No heavy sauce — just the good stuff.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Pat cod dry, place in baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, season with garlic powder, oregano, paprika, salt.
Bake 14–16 min until cod flakes easily.
Cook quinoa: rinse, simmer in 2× water 15 min, fluff. Jake 60g dry, Laine 50g dry.
Halve cherry tomatoes. Toss into warm quinoa with spinach — the heat wilts the spinach.
Plate: quinoa base, cod on top. Squeeze extra lemon over everything.

dinners.name: Grilled Chicken Pita Pockets
dinners.note: Pita Tuesday replaces tacos. Whole wheat pita filled with grilled chicken, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, and a yogurt-lemon spread. Jake bigger portions, Laine lighter. Fast and Laine-approved — no onions, mild spice only.

ingredients.item: Chicken breast — Jake 220g raw, Laine 140g raw
Greek yogurt (nonfat) — 3 tbsp shared, for spread
Cherry tomatoes — ½ cup shared, halved

steps: Pound chicken to even thickness. Season with olive oil, garlic powder, oregano, paprika, salt.
Cook in a pan over medium-high 4–5 min per side until cooked through. Rest 3 min, slice thin.
Mix yogurt with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of garlic powder and oregano for the spread.
Warm pitas 30 sec per side on dry pan or directly over burner.
Slice pita open, spread yogurt inside, stuff with chicken, tomatoes, cucumber, spinach. Jake gets 2 pitas.

dinners.name: Lemon Herb Chicken + Chickpea Skillet
dinners.note: Full Mediterranean Wednesday. Chicken + chickpeas + spinach + cherry tomatoes in one pan. No grain needed — fiber comes from the chickpeas. Olive oil and lemon tie everything together.

ingredients.item: Chicken breast — Jake 200g raw, Laine 140g raw

steps: Slice chicken. Season with garlic powder, oregano, cumin, salt.
Heat olive oil in skillet over medium-high. Cook chicken 3–4 min per side. Remove, rest.
Add chickpeas to the same pan. Warm 2 min, pressing a few lightly with spoon.
Add cherry tomatoes. Cook 2 min until slightly blistered. Stir in spinach until wilted.
Return chicken. Deglaze with lemon juice. Toss everything together. Jake gets the bigger bowl.

dinners.name: Baked Salmon + White Rice + Wilted Spinach
dinners.note: Salmon Thursday. Omega-3 night — fat numbers are high but it's all salmon and olive oil, which is the point. Jake bigger fillet. White rice for easy carbs, spinach in lemon oil alongside.

ingredients.item: Atlantic salmon fillet — Jake 180g raw, Laine 140g raw

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Brush salmon with olive oil, season with garlic powder, paprika, oregano, salt.
Bake 14–16 min. Let rest 2 min.
Cook rice per package. Jake 70g dry, Laine 75g dry.
Wilt spinach in a small pan with remaining oil + lemon over medium, 2 min.
Plate: rice base, salmon on top, wilted spinach alongside. Extra lemon to finish.

dinners.name: Cod + Cannellini Bean Skillet
dinners.note: Lean clean Friday. Cod on white beans is a classic of Mediterranean coastal cooking — simple, fast, almost no cleanup. The beans handle the carbs and fiber so there's no need for a grain side.

ingredients.item: Frozen cod — Jake 220g raw, Laine 160g raw
Cherry tomatoes — ½ cup shared, halved

steps: Thaw cod, pat dry. Season with garlic powder, oregano, salt.
Heat olive oil over medium-high. Cook cod 3–4 min per side. Remove.
Add beans and tomatoes to pan. Warm 2 min, lightly crushing a few beans.
Stir in spinach until wilted. Add lemon juice and stir through.
Plate bean mixture, cod on top. Big squeeze of lemon to finish.

dinners.name: Shrimp + Lemon Garlic Pasta
dinners.note: Weekend pasta, Mediterranean style. Olive oil and lemon instead of heavy sauce — shrimp, blistered cherry tomatoes, spinach. Jake bigger bowl. It comes together in under 20 minutes.

ingredients.item: Frozen shrimp — Jake 220g raw, Laine 180g raw
Garofalo pasta — Jake 90g dry, Laine 75g dry
Garlic powder, oregano, red pepper flakes (Jake only), salt

steps: Boil pasta in salted water al dente. Reserve ¼ cup pasta water. Drain.
Cook shrimp in olive oil over medium-high with garlic powder, oregano, salt — 2 min per side.
Add cherry tomatoes to pan, cook 2 min until slightly blistered.
Add spinach, stir until wilted. Add pasta + splash of pasta water. Squeeze lemon in.
Toss to coat. Jake gets bigger bowl, add red pepper flakes to his. Serve immediately.

dinners.name: Birch Benders Pancake Night + Egg White Scramble
dinners.note: Standing Sunday breakfast-for-dinner. Flaxseed in the batter. Thawed frozen fruit on top. Jake bigger stack. This one's sacred.

ingredients.item: Birch Benders pancake mix — Jake ¾ cup, Laine ½ cup
Liquid egg whites — Jake ½ cup, Laine ¼ cup
Frozen fruit (mixed) — ½ cup shared, thawed

steps: Thaw frozen fruit at room temp or microwave 60 sec.
Mix pancake mix + egg whites + water per pkg. Stir in flaxseed.
Cook on greased griddle over medium, 2–3 min per side.
Jake gets bigger stack. Top both with thawed fruit.

jakeLunch.name: Chicken + Chickpea Bowl with Lemon Herb Sauce
jakeLunch.note: Mediterranean pivot on the batch bowl. Same 5-container Sunday format. Chickpeas replace black beans. Garlic basil sauce + lemon. Edamame stays for protein.

ingredients.item: Chicken breast — 2.5 lbs total (227g raw per container)
Garbanzo beans — 2 cans total (0.4 can per container)
Garlic basil pasta sauce — 2.5 cups total (½ cup per container)
Frozen edamame (shelled) — 2.5 cups total (½ cup per container)
Frozen mixed veggies — 5 cups total (1 cup per container)

steps: Bake ALL chicken (2.5 lbs) at 400°F for 24 min. Cool and dice or shred.
Heat chickpeas in a pan with olive oil, garlic powder, cumin, salt — 5 min until slightly crispy.
Add pasta sauce, edamame, lemon juice. Simmer together 5 min.
Steam/microwave all frozen veggies separately.
Divide into 5 containers: chickpea + chicken mixture base, 1 cup veggies on top.
Drizzle with remaining lemon. Seal and refrigerate. Reheat 2 min with a splash of water.

laineLunch.name: Tuna & Chicken Pasta Salad — Mason Jar Style
laineLunch.note: Same mason jar format — bell pepper edition. Dressing kept separate. 2 sittings per jar. Laine approved, no modification needed.
laineLunch.dressingNote: Light Italian or Caesar — 2 tbsp per jar in a separate small container.

ingredients.item: Chicken breast — 2 breasts (~800g raw), 147g per jar
Garofalo pasta (rotini or penne) — 250g dry total, 50g per jar
Canned tuna in water — 1 can per jar (5 cans total)
Bell pepper — 1 large diced, ~100g per jar
Baby spinach — big handful per jar (~30g)
Light Italian or Caesar dressing — 2 tbsp per jar (kept separate)
Lemon juice, garlic powder, salt (for chicken)

steps: Season chicken with garlic powder, lemon juice, salt. Bake at 400°F for 24 min. Cool completely, dice small.
Cook pasta in salted water. Drain, rinse cold, toss with a tiny bit of olive oil.
Dice bell pepper. Slice cucumber. Rinse spinach.
Drain tuna well.
Layer each jar: pasta → tuna → cucumber → bell pepper → chicken → spinach on top.
Dressing in a separate small container per jar. Refrigerate.
To eat: pour dressing in, shake, eat half — reseal for second sitting.

laineBreakfasts.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
steps: Spoon yogurt into bowl or jar. Top with thawed fruit and flaxseed.

laineBreakfasts.name: Egg White Scramble
steps: Scramble egg whites over medium-low with frozen veggies until just set. Top with cheese.

laineBreakfasts.name: Birch Benders Pancakes + Fruit

ingredients.item: Birch Benders pancake mix — ½ cup dry

steps: Mix pancake mix + egg whites + water. Cook small pancakes 2 min per side. Top with fruit + flaxseed.

jakeSnacks.name: Egg White Mug + Cheese
jakeSnacks.desc: ½ cup liquid egg whites microwaved 90 sec in a mug. Top with 1 tbsp shredded cheese.

jakeSnacks.name: Tuna Straight from Can
jakeSnacks.desc: Drain and eat with a fork. Add hot sauce or lemon.
